story.titleZh: 哈贾尔做客《Beyond The Grid》畅谈红牛首个赛季
story.summaryZh: 伊萨克·哈贾尔在《Beyond The Grid》节目中与主持人汤姆·克拉克森对谈，回顾自己在红牛充满波折的首个赛季。他谈到了缺席三场比赛、与新签的红牛合同，以及担任维斯塔潘队友的感受等话题。
story.originalTitle: Isack has certainly had an eventful first season at Red Bull 👀 Speaking to Tom Clarkson on Beyond The Grid, @Isack_Hadjar opens up about missing th...
story.summaryEn:
Isack has certainly had an eventful first season at Red Bull 👀
Speaking to Tom Clarkson on Beyond The Grid, @Isack_Hadjar opens up about missing three races, his new Red Bull contract and what it's like being Max Verstappen's team mate... and so much more! 😮‍💨
#F1
detailZh: 伊萨克·哈贾尔在红牛的首个赛季可谓跌宕起伏👀。他在《Beyond The Grid》节目中与汤姆·克拉克森对谈，敞开心扉谈及缺席三场比赛、他的新红牛合同，以及担任马克斯·维斯塔潘队友的感受……还有更多话题😮‍💨。#F1
detailEn:
